```python
current_day = get_current_day()
yoga_events = search_calendar_events(query="Yoga Class", date=None)

# Filter for future events and sort by start time
future_yoga_events = [event for event in yoga_events if event.start_time > datetime.fromisoformat(current_day)]
future_yoga_events.sort(key=lambda x: x.start_time)

if not future_yoga_events:
    print("No upcoming Yoga Classes found.")
else:
    next_class = future_yoga_events[0]
    print(next_class.start_time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M"))
```
